newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 1997 coconut exports seen rebounding.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 1997 coconut exports seen rebounding.

text.p: The Philippines, largest exporter of coconut products in the world, expects coconut production to recover in 1997 after a sharp fall last year and its exports to approach the all-time high of $1.1 billion.
The state-run Philippine Coconut Authority said it also expects prices to remain steady or rise because of growing demand in local and overseas markets.

PCA Administrator Virgilio David said Friday he expected the country's coconut crop to increase to 2.7 million metric tons. Production fell to an estimated 2.2 million tons in 1996 after it reached an all-time high of 3 million in 1995, he said.
